notes: soundLAB 1.3.1: the Synth tab's buttons work with the MODX. The Arpeggiator, Motion sequencer, Scene and preset buttons now take every tap while the synth sends its MIDI clock (they used to be redrawn under your finger many times a second). The Deck and Live pages connect by themselves: a Connect button the first time, a quiet reconnect after that, and a clear note when the browser blocks MIDI, no synth is plugged in, the LUMI is chosen as the output, or the browser has no MIDI at all (Safari on iPad: use a Web MIDI browser app).
